notes: Ten-year-old R18 one-day dance festival (about 10,000) with alcohol, radio and DJ-gear partners plus a steady run of small-brand collab giveaways. A wellness studio (The Body Roll Studio, with Hydee electrolytes) already ran a giveaway, a low-cost entry precedent for High Ground. Sold out late Nov 2025; 2026 past fourth release by mid Oct.
